lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Cutey,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I have a favor to ask.
If this is another one of your experiments, I refuse.
I'm not available right now.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Do you think experiments are all I ever talk about?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: If that's true, then why are you responding to my message?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: There's something I want to discuss with you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Come with me up to the surface.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Ha, you're so adorable when you're confused.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: How much do you know about camping?
Depends on what you mean by camping.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm not talking about the kind of camping you do while out on a mission,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but the kind that you do for fun.
You mean setting up a tent, cooking some food over the campfire, stuff like that?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: There's a TV program on it that I'm watching right now.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Taking a tent and going out into the remote wilderness

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: may be uncomfortable at times,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but it's also terribly romantic.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Our hope is that when humanity reclaims the surface,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: there will come a day

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: when we all can stare at the starry night sky,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: and feel that sense of freedom wash over us once again.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Isn't that fantastic?!
Very much so.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: So, if for nothing else than for research purposes,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: would you like to take some camping equipment up to the surface?
That would be extremely dangerous.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I guess that's true.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: We probably shouldn't then...
We'll go when we reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hehe, okay!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Promise?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: This is great, because now I have something concrete to work towards.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm gonna buy this and that all in preparation for this momentous occasion!
